Title: Public Preview: Azure Open AI “Use your data” integration with Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB vCore

Body.Content:
The "Use your data" feature in Azure OpenAI Studio now integrates with Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB vCore. Harness the power of Retrieval Augmented Generation and vector search effortlessly, bringing your data directly into your OpenAI models.
 
Running models on your data empowers you to build complex and personalized LLM-powered applications tailored to your scenarios. You gain the ability to customize conversational AI content to your exact needs. Elevate your data-driven journey today with Azure OpenAI Studio and Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB vCore integration.

Learn More.
